dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible perimeters of the largest 'O' shaped structures exhibit a jagged, high-contrast gradient from dark-brown exterior to cream-colored boundary edges. The geometry of the primary central rings is irregularly elliptical with scalloped (crenulated) margins.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters are concentrated in the interstitial spaces between the larger rings, forming a dense network of asymmetrical spots. High-intensity (light) blobs are primary components of the ring perimeters rather than independent solid clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent lateral macro-annuli form a scalene triangle with the longest axis oriented parallel to the dorsal ridge. A chain of four smaller centroids forms a secondary curvilinear arrangement along the upper mid-section.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture pattern exhibits a 'reticulated' or net-like appearance where the light-colored annuli boundaries frequently intersect or merge, creating interconnected polygonal cells across the central flank.
